decisions.reason: It is close to the firm's hosting and compliance offer, fits its stated expansion of compliance capabilities, and the firm's own R&D makes it likely to learn from early agency interest rather than withdraw it.

This platform builds directly on the firm's core web hosting business, is prominent on the home page, and is exactly the kind of agency-focused feature set that a German hosting provider with in-house R&D would continue to develop.

A configurable managed hosting plan is highly related to the firm's established expertise and infrastructure, so with industry growth and strong absorptive capacity the firm is more likely to refine and retain it than remove it.
